objective: Gate 8G R2. Comprobar en SQL READ ONLY, usando el patron ya certificado de Gate8E, si el DEDICATED_MIGRATION_WRITER materializo la configuracion de 20260910_003_catalogo_ampliado_notifications_config.sql. Confirmar identidad EDARSAHUB/HRLectura y existencia activa de las 2 configuraciones provider, 2 templates y 2 configuraciones de modulo para EMAIL/WHATSAPP de Catalogo Ampliado. No devolver PayloadMongo, secretos, destinatarios ni texto de templates. Sin JSON_VALUE/ISJSON/OPENJSON.

queries.name: readonly_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_provider_flags
queries.sql: SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' THEN 'EMAIL' WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' THEN 'WHATSAPP' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS canal_flag,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%' THEN 'SMTP' WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%' THEN 'TWILIO' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS provider_flag FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%') OR (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%')) ORDER BY canal_flag,Id

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_template_flags
queries.sql: SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' THEN 'EMAIL' WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' THEN 'WHATSAPP' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS canal_flag,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS expected_template_code FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') ORDER BY canal_flag,Id

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_module_config_flags
queries.sql: SELECT Id,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' THEN 'EMAIL' WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' THEN 'WHATSAPP' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS canal_flag,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%' THEN 'SMTP' WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%' THEN 'TWILIO' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS provider_flag,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modo_envio\":\"real\"%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS real_mode,CASE WHEN LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS expected_template_code FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1 AND ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') ORDER BY canal_flag,Id

queries.name: catalogo_ampliado_materialization_counts
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"smtp\"%') OR (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"provider\":\"twilio\"%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS provider_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS template_rows,SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"modo_envio\":\"real\"%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"email\"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%\"canal\":\"whatsapp\"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS module_config_rows FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1

constraints: EMAIL must resolve SMTP and real mode
WHATSAPP must resolve TWILIO and real mode
